name: Thomas Heart

text.ability: At the colony, once a round, with a die of 5 or more Thomas takes down two zombies there and nobody rolls for exposure.
text.bio: Carries himself like a man who has already survived worse and says very little about it.

notes: Clean scan Survivor_Thomas_Heart.jpg matches influence, attack, search, ability location, die value and once-per-round limit. Die value confirmed as 5 or more: the clean scan prints (5+), not (5-).
